# P1.14 — Voices, full: Full Profile, staleness, the five-tab detail page

Spec: `docs/tickets/42_P1.14__voices-full.md` · run ledger: `docs/build/runs/P1.14.md`
**Stage A only** — all code + deterministic tests. Stage B (dev deploy + one instrumented
Full Profile build ≤$15 + the calibrator's live fetch round-trip) is operator-gated →
**D-P1.14-1**. Stacked on `stevevitali/p1-13-figures`; merge operator-held.

## Summary

The Voices workspace grows from PRB.10's Quick Voice into the full §9.1–§9.6 surface: the
three-group `/voices` destination, Full Profile builds behind the `approve_sample` gate, the
fetcher-only URL sample path with the §12.6 hold-out policy, the eight-state staleness pill
with its diff-of-inputs panel, one "Update voice" verb routed to the cheapest sufficient
scope, the five-tab detail page, consume-once profile corrections, the project adopt/fork
hatches behind the post-v1 soft lock, composite + register surfaces, the deterministic
`@rhema/measure` service, and the charter reseed that never touches guidance lines.

**Measure** (`@rhema/measure`, NEW leaf; contracts `domain/measure.ts`): deterministic,
dependency-free prose metrics — sentence-length / paragraph-sentences distributions,
per-1k rates (first/second person, questions, em-dash, colon/semicolon, parentheses),
type-token ratio, sentence openings; `measureProse` + `measureCorpus` (ranges beside means);
`calibrationRows` (target vs prediction vs real) + `withinOneBand` (feature-specific
tolerances) + `calibrationVerdict` implementing the ticket's in-body §16.3 #10 resolution:
`tested-badly-off` when fewer than half the compared rows are within band OR the blind
check picked the prediction.

**findings-core**: `voice-update.ts` — `routeVoiceUpdate` (REQ-SPEC-27 precedence:
badly-off → full rebuild; sample delta / aged → delta; seed-only → synth; untested →
calibrate) + `routeVoiceUpgrade` (Quick → `full_from_quick`) + `voiceFactsPanel` (the §9.3
four-facts popover in plain words, never hashes). `profile-surface.ts` — the fixed §9.4
Profile-tab section order (calibration report first; structure/audience collapsed;
voice-measures advanced), `approveSampleCard` (census counts, exclusions with plain-word
reasons, the never-naming hold-out line, estimate/cap, knobs, the calibration-off warning),
`checkVoiceBuildGate` (name + description-or-sample; Full ≥4 samples AND ≥2 readable ≥10w),
`holdoutRevealed`. `charter.ts` — `reseededCharter` (seeded lines regenerated from
name/byline/registers; the `## Guidance` section carried verbatim) + `guidanceSection` +
`lineDiff`. `holdout.ts` — `pickHoldout` (deterministic) + `holdoutMirrorPath`. Eight-state
`VOICE_STATES` live — `aged` + `badly_off` are reachable, not latent.

**Protocols** (private): `manifests/reseed_charter.ts` (single-phase persona-builder
manifest) registered in `WORKFLOW_MANIFESTS` + `SEAT_BY_WORKFLOW` + lock set;
`ESTIMATORS.reseed_charter` (C0 band) + `refresh_voice`/`calibrate_voice`/`profile_voice`
quick/full variants + `synth` scope pricing; `bootstrap-persona` SKILL.md gains the reseed
phase note (version bumped).

**Orchestrator**: persona finalize — `persona_profiles` write + `persona_build_notes` row +
`profile_corrections.consumed_by_profile_id` stamps (consume-once) + the §12.6 hold-out
leak audit (any non-calibrator HOLDOUT access/fetch row → `calibration_status='untested'`
+ a flagged build note) + hold-out `revealedAt` only on tested/valid outcomes; runspec
authors the persona `UrlPolicy` (holdouts + calibratorAllow + `serverFetchDisabled` for the
builder — the calibrator's allow-list arms only after `profile/calibration-prediction.md`
is written, enforced by the hook daemon's `predictionFileWritten` flip).

**Hooks** (`apps/run-task`): the daemon fails closed on malformed tool-use envelopes
(missing `tool_name` ⇒ deny), returns only the PreToolUse decision, and flips
`urlPolicy.predictionFileWritten` when an allowed write lands on the prediction path —
the §12.6 ordering is enforced in-process, not by skill honesty.

**API** (`voice-routes.ts`): `GET /voices` returns the §9.1 three-group split (your voices /
house styles / shared — read-only + forkable); `GET /voices/:id` carries the full workspace
read (factsPanel, updateRoute, upgradeRoute, hold-out with identity gated on reveal,
deterministic corpus measures, the calibration table post-reveal, corrections, the open
`approve_sample` card, composite members, build notes, hub markdown, the fixed section
order); `POST /voices/:id/samples/url` (fetcher-only — the fetch runs outside the write tx);
`POST /voices/:id/build` enforces the shared gate (422 `full_needs_four_samples` /
`full_needs_two_readable`); `GET|POST /voices/:id/update` (route + estimate; POST creates
`refresh_voice`/`calibrate_voice`/`profile_voice` by scope with the frozen UrlPolicy +
hold-out carry-forward); `POST /voices/:id/corrections` (seed blockquote + consume-once
row); `POST /voices/:id/fork`; `PATCH /projects/:id/voice` soft-lock 409 `voice_locked`
naming both hatches (register-only patches stay open); `POST /projects/:id/voice/adopt`
(pins the refreshed snapshot + decision log + optional `reseed_charter` run);
`POST /projects/:id/voice/fork` (new project at `outlined`, outline artifacts copied,
drafts never); `GET /projects/:id/voice/reseed-preview` (the adopt dialog's diff —
`guidancePreserved` asserted server-side).

**api-client**: the full P1.14 DTO set (`VoiceListDto` groups, `VoiceFactsPanel`/
`VoiceUpdateRoute`/`VoiceHoldoutDto`/`VoiceCalibrationDto`/`VoiceCorrectionDto`/
`VoiceGateCardDto`/`VoiceBuildNoteDto`, `ProjectVoiceDto.pinnedStale`, the update/correction/
fork/adopt/fork-project/reseed-preview request+response shapes) + `listVoiceGroups`,
`addVoiceSampleUrl`, `getVoiceUpdatePlan`, `updateVoice`, `addVoiceCorrection`, `forkVoice`,
`adoptProjectVoice`, `forkProjectVoice`, `getVoiceReseedPreview`, `decideRunGate` (run-scoped
gate resolution for persona runs).

**Web**: `/voices` renders the three groups with card anatomy (name+byline, pill, samples,
sources, projects, last-built, tier, "Composed from …", read-only note + Fork);
`/voices/new` gains the Full Profile radio + the URL sample field; `/v/:id` is five tabs —
Overview (pill, diff-of-inputs panel with the routed sentence, the one verb, the
approve_sample card, hub paragraph, generic hold-out line, projects), Description (seed
editor + corrections ledger + correction form + build notes), Samples (include/omit +
★ held-out badge post-reveal only + paste/file/URL), Profile (fixed §9.4 order, calibration
table, Advanced measures, read-only artifacts), Runs (build history + snapshots); the
project voice picker gains the register selector (multi-register voices) + the
pinned-stale hatches (Adopt / Preview the charter diff / Fork) + the `voice_locked` notice;
`/p/:slug/voice/reseed` renders the diff before commit.

## Not in this PR (Stage B → D-P1.14-1)

Live deploy + one instrumented Full Profile build (≤$15, operator-gated): the calibrator's
real fetch of the hold-out URL after the prediction write, the hook daemon's live flip, the
approve_sample card on a real run, `foldInstrumentedRun` constant calibration. Pod-side
`measure` tool dispatch is a harness-image concern folded into that leg.
